artworks.title: Across Bolham Water
artworks.medium: charcoal on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated vantage point. The horizon features hills and a distant structure. In the foreground, there are cows grazing in sections of a field. The composition transitions into open fields and hills leading to the horizon. The artwork is rendered in monochrome, with varying intensities of black and gray, creating a serene scene.

artworks.title: The Pantheon
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor and gouache over red chalk on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 10.4 x 13.8 cm (4 1/8 x 5 7/16 in.), oval
artworks.description: The image features an elevated viewpoint looking towards the front of the Pantheon, centrally placed within the composition. The horizon aligns with the rooftops of the surrounding buildings and the top of the Pantheon, emphasizing it as the focal point. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, capturing the intricate details of the architecture and urban landscape in a neoclassical style. The color palette is warm, dominated by beige, ochre, and light browns contrasting with the soft blue sky. A fountain with an obelisk is in the foreground, with the Pantheon and scattered figures beyond. Residential buildings frame the scene in the distance, enhancing symmetry, while soft clouds fill the sky.

artworks.title: A Painter's Studio with a Model Wrapped in Japanese Silk
artworks.medium: black chalk, watercolor, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a red folding chair, with her upper body turned towards an easel to the right. Her arms are crossed over her chest, and she has an elegant updo with loose strands framing her face. She is draped in a blue fabric with a floral pattern. Surrounding her are several large books or portfolios, and some sheets of paper are scattered on the floor. In the background, there is a lightly sketched image on the wall, a guitar hanging next to a framed picture on the left. The setting appears to be an artist's studio, with a plain wall and a wooden floor.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: black chalk with pen and brown ink and brush and light brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on light blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring a central figure surrounded by various other figures engaged in different actions. The main figure is depicted in a pose facing upwards, while the surrounding figures appear to be interacting with or responding to the central character. In the sky above, a figure is shown either flying or descending through the clouds. The surrounding figures are shown in different poses, hinting at a narrative of conflict or a historical/mythological event. The drawing uses soft, earthy tones with expressive linework to convey movement and emotion, with shading and cross-hatching to add depth and texture.

artworks.title: Navajo Trader
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an older individual facing slightly left, standing with their left arm raised and bent at the elbow. They are holding a small object between their thumb and index finger. The person has prominent facial features, deep lines, and a pensive expression. Their hair is dark and somewhat tousled, with a bandana wrapped around their head. They wear a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment with visible folds and texture. In the background is a plain, textured surface with no distinct features, serving as a neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Evening in the Gateway
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of men gathered at the entrance to an establishment. The scene is lively yet somber, capturing a moment of social gathering in an urban setting. One man on the left is reading a newspaper. The signage reads "Grand Café" with offerings such as "Soup" and "Hash Pie." A barber pole is visible on the left side of the entryway. Coats are hanging on the right side. The clothing and general appearance suggest a setting from the early to mid-20th century. The artwork style is influenced by the realist movement. This is in the style of Thomas Hart Benton.

artworks.title: Flooded Land
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a house on a hill surrounded by water, viewed from an elevated angle. The horizon is not visible, as land and water blend in the distance. The brushstrokes show flowing movement in the water and sky, with more defined lines for the land and house. The color palette is primarily black and gray. Two boats with figures inside are in the lower corners, and there are leaning power lines. Clouds cast shadows in the sky.

artworks.title: Refugees
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures walking up a rocky path with towering rock formations dominating the scene. The brushstrokes are bold, creating a contrast between light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. The figures are outlined and walking in single file. In the distance, the rock formations continue, and to the left, there are buildings among rolling hills.

artworks.title: Vegetable Market
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: A painting of a market scene outside a building with various produce on display. The artwork depicts an outdoor market setting, where a vendor is showing cucumbers to onlookers, while an assortment of produce such as green vegetables, apples, and pears are displayed. Signs indicate the items being sold and their prices. The scene is full of rich, earthy colors and detailed textures. The style is reminiscent of Diego Rivera, characterized by social realism and a focus on everyday scenes of work and life.

artworks.title: Indian Altar and Ruins of Old Zuni
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient ruins, trees, a man gesturing towards an altar with ceremonial objects and plants, and two figures observing from behind trees. The painting is detailed with precise brushstrokes capturing textures and features earthy tones and a pale blue sky.

artworks.title: Navajo Family
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of diverse individuals presented in a black and white sketch. In the foreground, an older woman with a walking stick stands with a younger woman holding two children. One child is bundled up and the other appears barefoot. To the right, two women are seated, one wrapped in a blanket and the other with a hooded garment. In the middle, two men sit on horses. The background depicts rocky terrain and sparse vegetation, with more individuals on horseback in the distance.

artworks.title: Temptation
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 185 x 260 mm
Sheet: 252 x 326 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a group of four figures near a tree. The central figure is standing holding two watermelons, wearing a jacket and pants. To his right, a young boy stands wearing a plaid shirt and belt. To the left, a seated man plays a banjo, wearing a hat and patchy pants. Another seated man is on the right, wearing a hat and loose-fitting clothes, with a basket of cotton beside him. The background shows tree branches and a hint of water.

artworks.title: Untitled (Shadows)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 189 x 264 mm
Sheet: 252 x 327 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows three African American figures outdoors. On the right, a woman holds a baby. Beside her is another woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat. In the background to the left, a person is on a horse partially submerged in water. Tall trees and dense vegetation surround the scene.

artworks.title: Sunday, Southern U.S.
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 183 x 253 mm
Sheet: 250 x 323 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a rural outdoor setting. There is a man standing with a hoe, a man sitting on a wooden structure, a figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat leaning on a cane, and another individual sitting on a barrel against a tree. The background includes sparse, leafless trees or bushes on grassy ground.

artworks.title: Moses and the Brazen Serpent
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with black wash and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of intertwined, muscular figures. The figures are depicted overlapping each other in a dynamic and chaotic arrangement. Most of the figures are nude, conveying a sense of motion and struggle. They are rendered in a classical style with strong chiaroscuro effects, emphasizing their musculature and expressions. Some figures have serpentine elements entwined around them, adding tension and drama to the scene. The drawing is in brown and white tones, giving it an aged, sculptural appearance like a bas-relief or a classical frieze.

artworks.title: Noah's Warning about the Coming Flood Goes Unheeded
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with black wash and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned drawing of a group of robed figures. The figures are arranged in a semi-circle, some standing and others seated or kneeling. One figure on the left raises a hand. The expressions and poses vary among the figures. Some are listening intently, while others gesture with raised hands or hold objects like a curved horn or musical instrument. The background includes architectural elements like beams and possibly a ceiling or latticework. The application of shading and line work gives the piece depth and texture, typical of a drawn study.

artworks.title: Moses and Aaron before Pharaoh, with the Rods Turned into Serpents
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with black wash and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures and snakes. The figures are in an indoor setting, with one central figure seated on a throne-like chair on the left side, engaging with others standing around him. The figures wear different expressions. Several serpents are on the floor. The palette is limited to shades of brown and gray, with fine lines outlining the characters and shadows.

artworks.title: Egyptian Sibyl
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright and facing forward. They have a defined face, delicate features, and long, curly hair. The person is wearing a robe with a sash tied around the waist. In their left hand, they hold a staff with a banner, and their right hand rests on an ornate shield with the word "Resurrezion" inscribed on it. The background is a plain surface with a textured pattern.

artworks.title: An Evening Landscape with a Hay Wagon
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of pen and black ink, heightened with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a farm vehicle loaded with hay, pulled by horses with figures seated on top and walking alongside. The landscape is lush with trees and shrubs, featuring a high horizon line and distant buildings or fields. The color palette is predominantly grey.

artworks.title: An Evening Landscape with Tall Trees
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees are silhouetted against the sky, with the horizon placed low in the composition. The scene features detailed pencil or graphite strokes to illustrate the branches and leaves of the trees. The sketch is monochromatic, using various shades of gray to create depth and texture. The closest trees have sparse branches, blending out into the sky. In the distance, a gradient suggests a lighter sky, creating contrast with the foreground foliage. The overall mood is serene, with a balance of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Male and Female Bathers with Umbrella
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on card
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures swimming in the ocean, holding an umbrella above the water. The painting depicts two individuals partially submerged in the water, holding a pinkish-brown umbrella overhead. The water is rendered with soft strokes, creating a gentle, rippling effect. The background is softly painted, suggesting distant landforms blurred with the effect of light rain. The figures' expressions and positions are relaxed and serene. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a Great Tree
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is a landscape captured from a slightly elevated point of view, showcasing a wide countryside. The horizon line is above the center, showing rolling hills and distant mountains. A large tree with detailed branches and leaves stands out in the middle. The scene is illustrated using fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. Nearby, there is a patch of land with a small creek, leading to two figures as silhouettes. The color palette is in beige and sepia tones, typical of an etching, giving an antique look to the artwork.

artworks.title: Eight Studies of Figures and a Ship at Sea
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash on greenish laid paper
artworks.description: The image features multiple small illustrations of male figures depicted in various seated and standing positions with attention to detail in their postures. The figures are shown in casual poses, with some seated with legs crossed or reclined on their sides, and others standing with their backs partially turned. The facial features are simply drawn with minimal lines, with short hair and some wearing hats. They are dressed in loose-fitting, long-sleeved tops and pants, some barefoot. One figure is reclining on an inclined surface. In the background is a sketch of a sailing ship with sails partially set. The backdrop is minimal to keep the focus on the figures. The line work is delicate and emphasizes the contours of the scene.

artworks.title: Ten Men Pulling on Ropes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on pale greenish laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaged in a physical activity involving ropes. The scene captures a group of individuals positioned in two rows, each holding and pulling on ropes. The figures exhibit dynamic movement, each leaning back as if exerting effort to pull the ropes. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette using simple line work and minimal shading, highlighting the outlines and postures of the figures. The background is left blank, focusing attention solely on the figures and their actions. The style is reminiscent of preparatory sketches by classical artists, emphasizing the anatomy and movement of the human form with clarity and precision.
